items.heading: People Who Want Earlier Stability,
items.text: People who want earlier stability, decent income, and lower regret.

items.heading: This Is the Best Fit
items.text: This is the best fit for most people because it puts stability before drama. The core idea is simple: choose a path that can create faster employability, stronger skill value, and clearer income growth first. Then let that foundation buy you more freedom later.

items.heading: If You Are Unsure, Default
items.text: If you are unsure, default toward the stronger income engine first. You can build experiments on top of stability more easily than you can build stability on top of chaos.

items.heading: If You Choose a Risky
items.text: If you choose a risky dream, fund the dream with a second skill. That protects both your money and your emotional clarity.

items.heading: If You Choose the Aggressive
items.text: If you choose the aggressive path, prove you can handle the pressure before making irreversible bets. Big upside without pressure tolerance usually collapses into random career thrashing.
